purpose: Select one finite complete-library factor-combination mechanism for Campaign101 without reading any of the 129 source-factor values, candidate values, comparison values, daily prices, or historical returns.

candidate_queue_review.reason: This would repeat the terminal equal-weight consensus family and would inherit or relax its failed common-finite support rather than test a new aggregation mechanism.
Selecting source factors by prior IC, return, cost, or gate outcomes would violate the complete frozen library rule and create unrecorded multiplicity.

A fitted model remains policy-permitted for a later separately frozen campaign, but Campaign101 first isolates one deterministic nonlinear complete-library breadth mechanism so its value and failure are attributable without a model or hyperparameter search.
Testing several related aggregators together would add avoidable formula multiplicity. Campaign101 freezes exactly one lower-quartile breadth statistic and no rescue alternative.

The 25th percentile of all frozen-direction component ranks asks whether at least a broad three-quarters of the complete numeric library jointly rank a stock favorably. It is nonlinear, resists a small number of extreme components, penalizes unavailable components as the worst state, and is not the terminal arithmetic-mean consensus.

selected_candidate.name: full_numeric_library_directional_lower_quartile_consensus_129f
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A stock whose lower quartile of frozen-direction ranks is high has broad confirmation across at least roughly three quarters of the complete microstructure, path, activity, market-relative, disclosure, and quality library, reducing dependence on a few extreme signals and potentially improving three-session execution robustness.
selected_candidate.source_factor_library_rule: Use every v54 numeric comparator in exact frozen order. Candidate49 and the three semantic-only definitions are absent because v54 classifies them outside the 129 numeric library, not because of observed performance.
selected_candidate.component_score: For every factor independently on each signal session, rank all finite quality/listing-base values by the factor's frozen direction using average ties and percentile ranks in (0,1]. A higher factor ranks ascending; a lower factor ranks descending.
selected_candidate.missing_semantics: After each component's independent finite-base ranking, map a missing component for that stock-day to exact directional score zero only inside this frozen aggregator. Do not fill or alter the immutable source snapshot.
selected_candidate.minimum_support_derivation: 97 = 129 - floor(0.25*129). At most 32 components may be missing, so the nearest-rank 25th-percentile order statistic at one-indexed position 33 is always a finite observed directional percentile rather than an imputed zero.
selected_candidate.formula: Let d_1..d_129 be the frozen-direction same-session percentile ranks with unavailable components replaced by 0. Require at least 97 originally finite components. Sort all 129 d values ascending and return d_(33), the one-indexed 33rd order statistic, equivalently the nearest-rank empirical 25th percentile ceil(0.25*129).
selected_candidate.tie_method: average within each source-factor cross-section; deterministic 33rd order statistic across components

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value mechanism and mandatory support-predicate audit, then freeze the exact v54-bound no-return protocol and conditional one-trial 2019-2023 walk-forward catalog before reading any source-factor value.
